text: Program Description Introduction Ever since its advent, BRICS, namely Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa, has followed the principles of openness and transparency, unity and mutual assistance, deepening cooperation, and pursuing mutual development, upheld the spirit of "Openness, Inclusiveness, Cooperativeness, and Win-win," and been committed to building closer, comprehensive, and consolidated partnerships. In addition to traditional economic and trade cooperation, cooperation among the BRICS countries also involves cultural exchange. Audiovisual media play a fundamental role in cultural exchange, and each BRICS country has many outstanding film professionals. With the aim of broadening the international horizons of young film professionals, promoting international film education, and innovating professional talent training, Beijing Film Academy has formulated the Beijing Film Academy Film Talents Promotion Program for BRICS. The program will support the overall national policy while facilitating exchanges in film education among BRICS members. In addition to China, each of the other BRICS countries—Russia, India, and South Africa—may send one international student to Beijing Film Academy to pursue a master's degree in a film-related field. There will be three international students in total, from Russia, India, and South Africa respectively, in 2019 to come and study for the master's degree.
